name: Stacey Dooley
bio: Stacey Dooley is an English TV presenter, documentary filmmaker and journalist who rose to fame in 2008 after appearing in BBC3's Blood, Sweat and T Shirts which highlighted child labour issues in developing countries. In 2009 she began hosting Stacey Dooley Investigates, an ongoing series of documentary films exploring issues such as drugs, sex trafficking, domestic violence, binge drinking, tourism, institutionalised sexism and terrorism in various corners of the globe. In December 2018 she won Strictly Come Dancing alongside professional dance partner, Kevin Clifton.
